dedupe_keys.name: shenzhen and jinan city scale camera derived vehicle trajectories

description: The Figshare collection groups city-scale vehicle trajectories reconstructed from traffic-camera observations in Shenzhen and Jinan with matching road-network node and edge tables. Its eight separately addressed child records each state CC0; the collection metadata does not declare a licence of its own. The article reports roughly five million recovered trajectories from more than 3,000 cameras across the two cities. CSV files can support traffic assignment, flow prediction or route-choice calibration. A caveat is that the trajectories are reconstructed between observed camera points, not direct continuous GPS traces, and detection or vehicle re-identification errors may affect paths. Camera coverage and collection dates differ between Shenzhen and Jinan, so users must preserve file-specific context. I read the own collection and child metadata plus article Data Records without downloading the large CSVs, auditing identity recovery or running a transport model. No directly related catalogue record was identified. The producer is Tsinghua FIB Lab.
